name: MSA Type 5 (attribute)
description: Attribute Measurement System Analysis — multiple appraisers, kappa-based agreement (Cohen, Fleiss, weighted)
whenToUse: When an attribute measurement system (good/bad, classes, ordinal levels) is to be assessed: several appraisers rate parts, repeatedly, against an optional reference. The result is kappa agreement, effectiveness and a verdict by AIAG or Bosch rules — not for measured characteristics, which types 1 to 3 cover. Requires a data collection with a part, an appraiser and a rating column; the wide layout (one column per appraiser and trial) cannot be fully operated through the surface.

table.noDisputes: No part is disputed — all appraisers agree.
table.noDisagreement: No misclassification and no inconsistent repeat.

charts.gageRun: Gage run chart (ratings by part and appraiser)

emptyState: Select part, appraiser and rating columns to start the analysis.
errUnknownReferenceLevel: Reference value "{value}" not among detected classes (part {part}).
errOrdinalLevelsUnordered: Ordinal ordering is not uniquely defined.
warnUnbalancedReps: Unequal replicate counts ({min}–{max}). Cohen κ uses min-alignment, Fleiss κ switches to Randolph.
warnAmbiguousConsensus: {count} part(s) without a unique consensus reference — excluded from effectiveness/κ vs. reference.
warnLowRepCount: None or too few replicates for: {appraisers}. Repeatability cannot be computed.
wideHint: Columns in worksheet order: all trials of appraiser 1 first, then appraiser 2 … The appraiser name is the common start of the column names (A-1, A-2 → A).
emptyStateWide: Choose the part column and the rating columns to start the analysis.
errWideColumnsNotDivisible: The {columns} rating columns cannot be split into groups of {trials} trials.
positiveHint: Default: the most frequent rating counts as OK. If that is wrong, use "Swap positive" — otherwise miss and false-alarm rate are swapped.
ordinalHint: Order follows sorted values; drag reordering will follow in a later version.
interp_good: Fleiss κ = {kappa}, effectiveness ≥ {minEff} %. Inspection process reproducible and consistent with the reference.
interp_marginal: Fleiss κ = {kappa}, minimum effectiveness {minEff} %. Marginal — train appraisers or sharpen rating criteria.
interp_unacceptable: Fleiss κ = {kappa}, minimum effectiveness {minEff} %. Not acceptable — the inspection process must be reworked.
interp_marginal_driver: {decisive}. Marginal — train appraisers or sharpen rating criteria.
interp_unacceptable_driver: {decisive}. Not acceptable — the inspection process must be reworked.

verdictNote.missFaNotRated: Miss and false-alarm rate not rated — the reference is the appraisers' consensus.

errCompute: MSA type 5 could not be computed: {msg}

invariants.uniqueRatings: Each rating column may be chosen only once
